1\. What is the current AQI (US) level in New York City?

The current real-time AQI (US) level in New York City is 22 (Good). This was last updated 2026-11-23 20:51:02 (Local Time).

2\. When was the best AQI (US) level in New York City in the last 24 hours?

The best AQI (US) level was 26 (Good) at 8:31 PM, Nov 23, 2026 (Local Time) during the last 24 hours.

3\. When was the worst AQI (US) level in New York City in the last 24 hours?

The worst AQI (US) level was 53 (Moderate) at 12:31 PM, Nov 23, 2026 (Local Time) during the last 24 hours.

4\. What is the current trend of AQI (US) levels in New York City during last 24 hours?

The AQI (US) levels in New York City have been fluctuating throughout the last 24 hours. The levels have increased by highest 53 at 12:31 PM, Nov 23, 2026 (Local Time), lowest 26 at 8:31 PM, Nov 23, 2026 (Local Time).

5\. What actions are recommended as per the current AQI (US) level in New York City?

The air quality is satisfactory, and air pollution poses little or no risk. No special precautions are needed; enjoy outdoor activities freely.
